notes.title: The Final Update
notes.notes:
In celebration of The Call of Karen's 3-year release anniversary, we've published one final update with a number of bug fixes and localization to 4 more languages!

See https://callofkaren.com/ for a full update on the status of the project and team

Changelog:

 Vacuum now shoots straight
 Soundtrack included
 Subtitles/UI localization (español, Português Brasileiro, Polski, 日本語)
 Made Cthulhu 6.66% more powerful
 Various minor bug fixes and improvements


Thank you to our amazing community translators:
♦ Myrt Cherel - Traduction Française
♦ WHRZ - 中文本地化
♦ Ехно Валерия - Перевод на русский
♦Elizabeth Matticoli - Localización en español
♦Lucas Yamashita - Português Brasileiro Localização
♦Szymon Duda - Tłumaczenie Na Język Polski
♦遠藤真理子、遠藤多美子　－　日本語通訳


Thanks for playing our game 💜🐙

notes.title: UPDATE: Captions/Localizations, Save/Load, More Settings
notes.notes:
One month has passed since we released The Call of Karen, and we are extremely grateful for all of the attention, praises, and feedback. 

In this exciting update:

Subtitles in English, French, Russian and Chinese
Save your progress up to the current day to take a break, or replay your favorite level
Adjust mouse sensitivity in the pause menu
Numerous bug fixes
CTHULHU PHTAGN R’LYEH


If you would like to support further development of The Call of Karen, visit https://callofkaren.com/ to find out how!

Special thanks to our volunteer translators:
Myrt Cherel - Traduction Française
WHRZ - 中文本地化
Ехно Валерия - Перевод на русский


If you would like to volunteer to translate The Call of Karen to your language, reach out to us via the contact form at https://callofkaren.com

Thanks again, and remember- Don't Let the Octopus Into Your Home 🐙
